queries.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND table_schema NOT LIKE '_timescaledb%' ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND (column_name ILIKE '%cik%' OR column_name ILIKE '%security%' OR column_name ILIKE '%valid%' OR column_name ILIKE '%detect%' OR column_name ILIKE '%flag%' OR column_name ILIKE '%snapshot%' OR column_name ILIKE '%announce%' OR column_name ILIKE '%source%' OR column_name ILIKE '%effective%' OR column_name ILIKE '%consensus%') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT DISTINCT accession_number, issuer_cik, insider_cik, filing_date FROM public.form4_transactions WHERE issuer_cik = 1133421 AND insider_cik = 1539147 AND filing_date = DATE '2018-02-15' ORDER BY accession_number

SELECT CASE WHEN filing_date IS NULL THEN 'missing_filing_date' WHEN filing_date < DATE '2015-01-01' THEN 'before_insider_scope' WHEN filing_date > DATE '2026-04-30' THEN 'after_cutoff' ELSE 'in_scope' END AS scope, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM filing_date)::integer AS filing_year, count(*)::bigint AS stored_rows, count(DISTINCT symbol)::bigint AS symbols, count(DISTINCT issuer_cik)::bigint AS issuers, count(DISTINCT accession_number)::bigint AS accessions, count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_transaction_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date < DATE '1990-01-01')::bigint AS transaction_before_1990, count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date > filing_date)::bigint AS transaction_after_filing, count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date > CURRENT_DATE)::bigint AS transaction_after_query_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_10b5_1_plan IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_stored_plan_flag, CURRENT_DATE AS query_date FROM public.form4_transactions GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT CASE WHEN earnings_date IS NULL THEN 'missing_earnings_date' WHEN earnings_date < DATE '2002-01-01' THEN 'before_pead_scope' WHEN earnings_date > DATE '2026-04-30' THEN 'after_cutoff' ELSE 'in_scope' END AS scope, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM earnings_date)::integer AS earnings_year, count(*)::bigint AS stored_rows, count(DISTINCT symbol)::bigint AS symbols, count(*) FILTER (WHERE eps_estimate IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_estimate, count(*) FILTER (WHERE eps_reported IS NULL)::bigint AS missing_reported, CURRENT_DATE AS query_date FROM public.earnings_surprise GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('symbol_inception','universe_cache','ohlcv_no_data','earnings_surprise','form4_transactions') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

summary.limitation: Stored row counts, not PIT coverage, source completeness, raw linkage or strategy events.
